claim: Only dev, build and preview scripts exist; no lint, typecheck or test script.
Repository presents itself as a checked Markdown network compiler with schema-validated extraction and deterministic rendering.
Canonical domain model is a single AgentManifest, not a graph of agents and tasks.
Extraction is keyword/rule based; no runtime schema validator is invoked; createdAt uses current time.
Blueprints and files are rendered from manifest, but dependency references are hand-maintained metadata.
Validation uses section checks, metadata references and regex/manifest heuristics with a penalty score.
Build stage UI uses timeouts; actual composeFiles execution occurs only at the final timeout.
Individual file save removes directory components using split('/').pop().
19 TS/TSX files, 3032 source lines, no fetch/WebSocket/persistence API and no test files were detected.
npm ci did not complete in the audit environment; build then lacked vite and typecheck lacked @types/node. This does not prove a repository defect.
